title: Multiple Choice - Opposite in Meaning
description: Choose the word or phrase OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.text: The new startup founder was remarkably [ambitious], aiming to expand services to thirty countries within two years.
After years of colonial governance, the nation finally established an [independent] parliament to govern its territory.
The allied general managed to [defeat] the hostile coalition after a strategic standoff in the river valley.
Doctors initially feared that the critically injured explorer might [pass away] during the blizzard, but emergency treatment kept him stable.
When Lucas received the confirmation letter that he had won first prize, he was [on top of the world].
